description: MuseDraw gallery: 101 original cases. flagship = curated front-page set; reviewed = visually inspected; preview = rendered, passes layout checks, awaiting design review.

items.title: Retrieval-augmented generation, end to end
items.subtitle: Two pipelines share one vector index. Documents are chunked and embedded ahead of time; each question is embedded, matched, re-ranked and grounded before the model writes a word.

items.title: Production Kubernetes cluster across three zones
items.subtitle: Reference deployment for a stateless web + API workload on EKS. AZ-a is drawn in full; AZ-b and AZ-c mirror it.

items.title: GitOps delivery pipeline: commit to production
items.subtitle: GitOps delivery: CI builds and signs one image; a bot bumps the tag in the env repo; Argo CD and Argo Rollouts do the rest, gated by live metrics.

items.title: How a card payment is authorized
items.subtitle: From tap to “Paid”, only messages travel. Funds settle between banks later, in a nightly batch.

items.title: MVP architecture, six-week scope
items.subtitle: Boring tech, one region, managed everything — and a clear line around what we are NOT building yet.

items.title: Event streaming with Kafka
items.subtitle: Producers append to topics. Topics are split into partitions and replicated across brokers. Every consumer group reads at its own pace, from its own offset.

items.title: OpenTelemetry observability pipeline
items.subtitle: Apps emit metrics, logs and traces over OTLP. Collectors enrich, sample and route them, and every signal keeps its own colour from source to dashboard.

items.title: Inside a tool-using AI agent
items.subtitle: The model never touches the world directly. It plans, asks the runtime to call a tool, reads the result and decides again — inside guardrails, with memory on both sides.

items.title: E-commerce microservices
items.subtitle: Shape tells the role: squares answer requests, circles react to events, the diamond routes traffic. Red lines are events on the bus.

items.title: PostgreSQL streaming replication and failover
items.subtitle: Every write lands in the write-ahead log first. Standbys replay that log; a consensus store decides who leads when the primary goes quiet.

items.title: 图 7 | 论文投稿到出版的典型时间线
items.subtitle: 以一篇 SCI 临床研究为例，从选刊到见刊约 200 天，其中超过一半在等待审稿。天数为示例，不同期刊差异很大。

items.title: 城市数据共享交换平台总体架构
items.subtitle: 各委办局的数据先归集、再治理、后共享。资源统一编目，接口统一网关，每一次调用都可追溯。

items.title: Multi-tenant SaaS: pooled and silo tiers
items.subtitle: One codebase and one pipeline serve every tenant. The tier in the token decides where a request runs: shared infrastructure for Starter and Pro, a dedicated account for Enterprise.

items.title: Food delivery platform — Container diagram
items.subtitle: C4 level 2. The deployable units inside the platform boundary, and how people and external systems use them.

items.title: Real-time multiplayer game backend
items.subtitle: Lobby traffic is ordinary HTTPS. Gameplay is UDP through edge relays to one authoritative server pod per match; everything slow happens off the hot path.

items.title: 实时协同编辑（CRDT）架构
items.subtitle: 两个人同时改同一段文字，为什么不会互相覆盖？每个客户端都有完整副本，只交换“增量”，而合并结果与到达顺序无关。

items.title: 2027 年度 OKR 目标树
items.subtitle: 新业务收入由 1.2 亿增至 2.4 亿元，下接四个关键结果，再接具体举措与负责团队。保留当前完成度、风险状态和 50% 时间标记，以黄紫分支区分目标组。

items.title: 新员工 90 天入职计划
items.subtitle: 按天排期，三条线并行推进。橙色虚线标出第 30、60、90 天的一对一复盘，复盘标准见下方。

items.title: 采购审批跨部门泳道图：协作矩阵
items.subtitle: 五个角色沿横向八阶段协作，显示预算退回、超过 5 万元加签、发货验收和三单匹配付款。用紫色阶段栏、粉色操作块和浅灰泳道区分层级。

items.title: Product roadmap FY2027
items.subtitle: Four tracks, one calendar. Bars are committed work, the outline bar is a bet we will size in Q2, and diamonds are dates we have promised to customers.

items.title: Customer journey map
items.subtitle: One customer type, six stages. The curve is how they feel; the clay cards are where a small fix removes a big dip.

items.title: Self-serve funnel, last 90 days
items.subtitle: Every step loses people. The question is which loss is cheapest to fix — here it is activation, not traffic.

items.title: 区域连锁咖啡品牌 SWOT 分析
items.subtitle: 内部看优势与短板，外部看机会与威胁。右下角的组合最危险：把短板暴露在威胁面前。

items.title: 本周任务四象限
items.subtitle: 不是所有紧急的事都重要。每周一把待办写成便签，贴进四个格子，再决定今天做哪一格。

items.title: 神经内科住院患者跌倒率改善
items.subtitle: 2026 年 1–9 月，每千住院日跌倒次数（‰），按 PDCA 阶段着色。目标为基线 1.8‰ 减半。数据为示例。

items.title: 夜间如厕跌倒根因分析
items.subtitle: 数字为该原因在 23 份事件记录中出现的次数（可重复计入）。加粗的三项出现最多，进入对策拟定。数据为示例。

items.title: Organization chart, Q3 2027
items.subtitle: 57 people today, 9 open roles. Three product squads own outcomes end to end; platform and design are shared. Each dot is one person. Names are illustrative.

items.title: Incident response runbook
items.subtitle: One decision decides severity; after that the order is always the same: assemble roles, mitigate, verify, then learn. Diagnosis can wait until users are safe.

items.title: RACI matrix: feature launch
items.subtitle: Exactly one A per row. If a row has no R, nobody is doing it; if it has five Cs, the meeting will be long.

items.title: 办公楼装修工程 · 进度计划
items.subtitle: 16 周、4 个阶段、2 个验收节点。黄色竖线为当前进度（第 7 周），关键路径：管线 → 隐蔽验收 → 吊顶 → 涂料 → 竣工。

items.title: Business model canvas: meal-kit service
items.subtitle: Nine boxes, one page. Read it from the right: who the customer is, what we promise them, and only then what it costs to deliver.

items.title: Stakeholder map: CRM migration
items.subtitle: Plot every stakeholder by influence and interest before the first meeting. The quadrant tells you how to engage; the arrow shows where you need someone to move.

items.title: Hiring funnel: senior backend engineer
items.subtitle: Each stage has an owner and a time limit. Candidates remember the slow stage, not the hard one — so the SLA is part of the design.

items.title: 费用报销审批流程
items.subtitle: 金额决定谁审批，票据决定能不能付款。大部分退回发生在财务审核这一步，且原因高度集中。数据为示例。

items.title: Team operating rhythm, one week
items.subtitle: Meetings cluster on Monday and Friday so Tuesday and Thursday stay empty. Red blocks are the two rituals nobody skips.

items.title: 新品发布会筹备清单
items.subtitle: 每一项写上负责人和截止日期。红色三项是上次发布会最后一周才想起来的风险，这次提前定好预案。

items.title: 2027–2029 战略能力地图
items.subtitle: 浅蓝屋顶呈现 2029 年服务 50 万户、营收 30 亿元、NPS 至少 60 的目标；四根支柱展示逐年指标，组织支撑作底座，橙色基础层表示年度复盘。模块具有轻微厚度与投影。

items.title: 公司 2026 年度大事记
items.subtitle: 一条主线，八个站点。红色站点是改变公司规模的节点，其余是能力建设。

items.title: 《沉与浮》教学流程
items.subtitle: 五个环节按时长等比例排开；上排是老师做什么，下排是孩子做什么。

items.title: 一年级数学一学期课程地图
items.subtitle: 四条线路 = 四个领域；站点 = 有课的周；两个换乘大站是测评。一眼看出哪几周内容最密、哪几周适合做项目。

items.title: Risk heat map, Q3 review
items.subtitle: Likelihood × impact decides the colour; owners and mitigations live next to the grid so the picture and the plan never drift apart.

items.title: Conference run of show
items.subtitle: The whole day on one sheet: who is on, where, and the two moments the crew cannot miss.

items.title: GTD weekly workflow
items.subtitle: Everything goes into the inbox. Every item gets exactly one decision — then it leaves.

items.title: Vendor scoring matrix: CRM selection
items.subtitle: Agree the criteria and their weights first, score each vendor 1–10 against them, and let the arithmetic start the discussion — not end it.

items.title: ADKAR readiness survey
items.subtitle: Score each step and fix the first one below 3. Desire is the barrier here, so more training (Knowledge) would be wasted until people want the change. Figures are illustrative.

items.title: 公文办理流程
items.subtitle: 一件来文经过八道手续，正常约 10 个工作日办结。朱砂色为需要领导签批的环节，虚线为退改回路。

items.title: 门诊就诊流程优化
items.subtitle: 线下 9 步里有 4 步在排队。把挂号、缴费、报告搬到手机上之后，患者在院时间从 2.5 小时降到 70 分钟。

items.title: AARRR growth funnel and experiments
items.subtitle: Five numbers the whole team can recite. Each stage owns exactly one live experiment; the hottest stage gets the most engineering time.

items.title: Fresh-produce supply chain: goods, information, money
items.subtitle: Amber is product moving towards the shelf, teal is demand data moving back to the farm, violet is money. A forecast is only as good as the teal lines.

items.title: Contract review triage
items.subtitle: Standard paper on our template goes straight to signature. Only the exceptions — non-standard terms, high value, personal data — get human review.

items.title: Team Topologies: four team types
items.subtitle: Stream-aligned teams ship to customers. Everyone else exists to make them faster — and says how: collaborate, facilitate, or offer X-as-a-service.

items.title: Tiered customer support model
items.subtitle: Each escalation costs roughly five times the tier before it. The goal isn't fewer tickets — it's tickets landing where they can be closed in one touch.

items.title: Sales pipeline board, week 41
items.subtitle: A deal that hasn't moved in 21 days goes back to Lead with a note. The column totals are the forecast; the cards are the conversation.

items.title: 幼儿园大班一日活动流程
items.subtitle: 动静交替、室内外交替。时间是骨架，不是闹钟：孩子玩得投入时，老师可以把下一环节推后十分钟。

items.title: 护士交接班 SIPOC
items.subtitle: 先画清楚边界：谁提供、提供什么、经过哪五步、产出什么、交给谁。改进时只动中间那一列，左右两列是约束。

items.title: Value stream map: bracket assembly
items.subtitle: Current state. Material moves left to right, information right to left; the ladder at the bottom shows how little of the 14 days is actual work.

items.title: Fig. 1 | PRISMA 2020 flow diagram
items.subtitle: Identification of studies via databases and registers for a systematic review of exercise interventions in older adults. Counts reconcile at every step (2,454 − 704 = 1,750; 1,750 − 1,512 = 238; 238 − 11 = 227; 227 − 191 = 36 reports).

items.title: Fig. 2 | CONSORT 2010 participant flow
items.subtitle: Two-arm, parallel-group randomised trial of a nurse-led discharge programme; primary outcome 30-day readmission, intention-to-treat. Counts are illustrative.

items.title: Transformer architecture
items.subtitle: Two stacks of identical blocks. The encoder turns a sentence into context-rich vectors; the decoder writes the output one token at a time while attending to them.

items.title: 肝纤维化多组学研究技术路线
items.subtitle: 三条研究任务并行，按样本与模型、研究方法、检测与评价分层，再汇入整合分析和预期成果。以研究阶段组织浅色横带，保留临床队列、细胞机制和动物验证的对应关系。

items.title: Explanatory sequential mixed-methods design
items.subtitle: Capital letters mark the dominant strand. The connecting step is where most designs go wrong: the qualitative sample must be chosen from the quantitative results, not by convenience.

items.title: Machine-learning model lifecycle
items.subtitle: Every arrow is a recorded artifact: dataset hash, feature version, run ID, model version. If you cannot replay a box, it is not part of the pipeline yet.

items.title: Fig. 4 | Generating a validated CRISPR–Cas9 knockout cell line
items.subtitle: a, Eight steps from guide design to phenotype, with typical timing for an adherent human line. b, Gates that must pass before moving on; skipping clone-level validation is the most common source of irreproducible knockouts.

items.title: Single-cell RNA-seq analysis pipeline
items.subtitle: Ten steps, three places where a bad default silently ruins the result. Thresholds shown are where we start, not what we publish — always inspect the QC plots first.

items.title: Western blot protocol, two-day schedule
items.subtitle: The overnight primary incubation splits the protocol cleanly. Yellow is the cheapest check in the whole workflow — never skip the Ponceau stain.

items.title: Clinical trial phases and success rates
items.subtitle: Each phase answers one question with more people and more money. Most drugs stop at the second one.

items.title: 文献综述写作流程
items.subtitle: 八步、约 14 周。左边是每一步占用的时间，中间是还剩多少篇文献，右边是这一步必须留下的记录。1,204 篇检索结果最终纳入 38 篇。数据为示例。

items.title: 学位论文章节结构
items.subtitle: 答辩委员读论文时，心里问的就是这六个问题。写每一章之前，先把问题写在页首。

items.title: Structural equation model: nurses' adoption of e-charting
items.subtitle: Ellipses are latent constructs measured by the boxed survey items. Every path coefficient is standardised; thick arrows carry the strongest effects (n = 486).

items.title: 图 2 | 量表编制与检验流程
items.subtitle: 示例：老年人智慧养老数字适应量表。右侧条形显示每一步之后保留的条目数——从 62 条到 24 条，每一次删减都有统计或专家依据。

items.title: FAIR research data workflow
items.subtitle: Raw data is read-only from the moment it leaves the instrument. Everything after it is produced by versioned code, so any figure can be regenerated from scratch.

items.title: Journal peer-review timeline
items.subtitle: Time runs down the page. Most of the five months are spent in the two long gaps — reviewer invitations and the author's revision — not in anyone's actual reading.

items.title: Denoising diffusion: training and sampling
items.subtitle: Training adds Gaussian noise in 1,000 small steps and teaches one network to predict it. Generation runs the chain backwards, about 30–50 steps with a modern sampler, steered by the text.

items.title: LLM evaluation pipeline
items.subtitle: A fixed set of cases, three kinds of graders, and a CI gate. The LLM judge is calibrated against humans on a sample every week — otherwise it quietly drifts.

items.title: 图 4 | 多阶段分层整群抽样设计
items.subtitle: 示例：全国老年人数字生活调查。先分层保证代表性，再整群降低成本，最后户内随机抽取一位 60 岁以上成员。括号内为样本量。

items.title: Global carbon cycle, annual fluxes
items.subtitle: Boxes are stocks in billions of tonnes of carbon (GtC); arrows are yearly flows. Of the ~11 GtC humans add each year, the land and ocean take back a little more than half.

items.title: 2 × 2 factorial experimental design
items.subtitle: Crossing two factors answers both main effects and whether they interact — with the same participants a one-factor study would need.

items.title: 课题进度安排（2027–2029）
items.subtitle: 申请书里的“年度计划”画成一张图：三条研究内容错峰推进，中期检查前完成机制研究的主体实验。

items.title: Fig. 5 | Conceptual model: moderated mediation
items.subtitle: Workload (X) increases burnout (Y) partly through sleep quality (M). Social support (W) weakens the first path. Hypotheses H1–H4 map to the labelled paths.

items.title: Reproducible R analysis pipeline
items.subtitle: Each box is a function; each arrow is an object cached by {targets}. Change the cleaning rule and only the downstream boxes rerun.

items.title: 分级夜间巡视降低老年住院患者跌倒率
items.subtitle: 作者 A，作者 B，作者 C ｜ 某三甲医院神经内科 ｜ 2026 年全国护理学术年会。数据为示例。

items.title: 肝纤维化小鼠模型分组与给药方案
items.subtitle: C57BL/6 雄性小鼠 50 只，随机分为 5 组，每组 10 只。造模 6 周，第 3 周起给药。剂量与时间点为示例。

items.title: Network of evidence for chronic insomnia treatments
items.subtitle: 33 randomised trials, six treatments. Every line is at least one direct comparison; everything else is inferred. Counts are illustrative.

items.title: 研究生培养关键节点
items.subtitle: 四条线并行推进，三个换乘站是学院统一的考核节点：开题、中期、答辩。月份为示例，按本校培养方案调整。

items.title: 文献管理工作流
items.subtitle: 从检索到写作，每篇文献只录入一次。五个工具各管一步，靠同一个引用键串起来。

items.title: 问卷调查实施流程与质控点
items.subtitle: 琥珀色是两道质控关口：平台自动筛掉可疑问卷，质控员再随机回访 10%。共回收 1,312 份，有效 1,186 份（90.4%）。数据为示例。

items.title: 三级编码：从原话到核心范畴
items.subtitle: 16 位老年住院患者半结构访谈。左列是原话片段，中列是归并后的主范畴，右侧是统领全部范畴的核心解释。示例数据。

items.title: 全膝关节置换术临床路径（标准住院日 6 天）
items.subtitle: 横向是住院日，纵向是谁负责。同一列读下来，就是这一天四方各自要完成的事。内容为示例，以本院路径为准。

items.title: Chemicals, from order to disposal
items.subtitle: Six steps every reagent goes through. Storage is where most incidents start, so it is the one step in red.

items.title: GWAS pipeline, genotypes to Manhattan plot
items.subtitle: Each step prints what it removed. Amber steps drop data; read their counts before trusting a single hit. Numbers are illustrative.

items.title: Federated learning across five hospitals
items.subtitle: Teal arrows carry weight updates in, violet arrows carry the new global model out. Raw images stay inside each hospital. Figures are illustrative.

items.title: 会议纪要与行动项
items.subtitle: 会议只产出两样东西：决议和行动项。每个行动项都有一个负责人、一个日期和一个状态，不写“相关部门”“尽快”。

items.title: 2027 年度预算编制时间表
items.subtitle: 9 月启动，12 月董事会批准，1 月起执行。琥珀色两轮评审最容易延期：每拖一周，后面的审批都要顺延。

items.title: 员工晋升通道：专业线与管理线
items.subtitle: 两条线在 P3 换乘：之后可以继续做专家，也可以转去带团队。同一高度的站点，薪酬区间相同。职级名称为示例。

items.title: Brand launch, planned backwards from launch day
items.subtitle: Start from the date and work back. Trademark clearance and the first production run are the two long poles; everything else fits around them.

items.title: 客诉处理闭环与时限
items.subtitle: 五步，每一步都有时限。处理环节最长也最容易超时；最后一步“复盘”才是闭环：同一类问题不再出现，才算真的处理完。数据为示例。

items.title: New café opening schedule
items.subtitle: Sixteen weeks from lease to grand opening. Critical path in yellow: fit-out, then the food safety permit, which cannot be applied for until fit-out passes fire inspection.

items.title: Cross-team weekly status
items.subtitle: Six projects, one line each. Leadership reads the red row first; it is the only one that asks them for something.

items.title: 科室知识库目录结构
items.subtitle: 一级目录按“用来做什么”分，不按部门分；文件统一以“年月日_名称_版本”命名，新人入职第一周就能自己找到。

items.title: 家园沟通四个频率
items.subtitle: 日常沟通按固定节奏走，家长知道什么时候能得到什么信息；特殊情况单独处理，不占用日常渠道。

items.title: 采购审批跨部门泳道图：纵向审批
items.subtitle: 申请人、部门经理、采购部、财务部和供应商各占一列，流程从上向下推进。黄色表示操作，黑色菱形表示判断，保留预算退回、大额加签和付款凭证分支。
